working.title: Pre-registered test completed
working.desc: Rules and test frozen and committed before three untouched sectors were downloaded; every number on the Overview page comes from that test via headline.json and is rebuilt by one command from frozen data.

working.title: Leverage cost bug fixed
working.desc: 2x leverage had been charged trading costs as if 1x. Fixed in the engine and covered by a test on 20 Oct 2026. The figures that replaced it were later withdrawn too, because they were measured on data that had helped choose the rule.

working.title: Sector RS rate-shock gate
working.desc: Replaced an overfit yield-level rule (4.2%) with a sector relative-strength gate: IT 20-day underperformance plus rate acceleration.

working.title: Paper trader running
working.desc: Paper trading since 2026-05-30 on NSE sector rotation, with experimental options and a frozen straddle tracked separately. Current figures are on the Live page.

failed.title: No edge over buy-and-hold after costs
failed.desc: On untouched sectors from 2021, after costs, no timing rule, causal filter or reinforcement-learning agent beat buy-and-hold. VIX_GATE's shallower drawdowns came from holding less: a fixed index mix with the same exposure had a smaller worst fall.
failed.metric: No statistical evidence of an edge

failed.title: Reinforcement-learning agents
failed.desc: GTrXL and MLP agents (five seeds each), trained only on the design sectors before 2021, did no better than plain momentum on the untouched sectors.

failed.title: Nifty straddle
failed.desc: Failed out-of-sample. Only 7.6% of a 576-combination parameter grid had a positive Sharpe ratio (research log section 16.7). Frozen.

failed.title: ADX+MOM20 blended portfolio
failed.desc: In-sample only; ADX threshold grid-searched on the same data; blend included the failed straddle. Earlier headline figures based on it are withdrawn.

failed.title: Causal signal filters
failed.desc: Adding causal filters to the VIX gate lowered its Sharpe ratio. 368 signals tested, 11 pass p<0.05 (3%), about what chance predicts.

failed.title: Weekly directional options
failed.desc: Direction signal real, but option time decay erased the edge and the signal set was chosen on the same data. Earlier Sharpe figures withdrawn.

failed.title: No bear-market strategy
failed.desc: No validated strategy for a prolonged bear market.

risks.title: Pre-2017 data quality
risks.desc: NSE options were 80 to 90% zero-volume before 2017. Option backtests there use theoretical settle prices.

risks.title: Multiple testing
risks.desc: Many strategies and parameters were tried on the same history. Deflated Sharpe ratios account for this and are near zero.

risks.title: No live execution
risks.desc: All results are backtest or paper. Live slippage, margin and execution risk are not captured.

next.title: Accumulate paper evidence
next.desc: Keep paper trading VIX_GATE unlevered; judge only on data after the parameter lock.

next.title: Bear-market research
next.desc: Look for a strategy that holds up in prolonged bear markets, with an out-of-sample split declared before testing.

next.title: Validate before reporting
next.desc: Every headline figure comes from engine result files via headline.json and is checked against them on every build.

roadmap.title: Paper evidence
roadmap.desc: Paper trade VIX_GATE unlevered with locked parameters.

roadmap.title: Bear-market strategy
roadmap.desc: No validated strategy survives a prolonged bear market. Declare the out-of-sample split first.

roadmap.title: Cost model audit
roadmap.desc: Re-check cost and leverage handling in every backtest after the 20 Oct 2026 bug.

roadmap.desc: Keep superseded results out of every page; the content check enforces it.

roadmap.title: Live execution
roadmap.desc: Only if paper results show an edge. Not planned before then.
